biomarkers.name: MDM2 amplification (12q13-15)
biomarkers.clinical_use: Defining feature  distinguishes from lipoma and other spindle cell tumours. MDM2 inhibitor trials (milademetan, brigimadlin)

biomarkers.name: CDK4 amplification (12q13-14)
biomarkers.prevalence: Co-amplified with MDM2 in most cases (~90%)
biomarkers.clinical_use: Palbociclib and other CDK4/6 inhibitors have some activity in DDLPS

biomarkers.name: HMGA2 amplification (12q14)
biomarkers.prevalence: Common, especially in ring/giant marker chromosomes involving 12q13-15

histomorphological_subtype.primary_pattern: Well-differentiated: mature adipocytes with atypia and lipoblasts; dedifferentiated: high-grade non-lipogenic sarcoma component adjacent to WD component
variants: well-differentiated (atypical lipomatous tumour when in extremities)
histomorphological_subtype.grading: WD is low-grade; DD is intermediate- to high-grade, most often high-grade

tumor_microenvironment.immune_context: Not well characterised; typically minimal inflammation
tumor_microenvironment.stromal_features: Mature adipocytic component with fibrous septa; DD component is desmoplastic non-lipogenic sarcoma

cellular_states_and_lineage.cell_of_origin: Mesenchymal cells with adipocytic differentiation potential (fibroblast-like precursors, not mature adipocytes)
cellular_states_and_lineage.differentiation_state: WD component retains mature adipocyte differentiation with variable atypia; DD component loses adipocytic differentiation and usually shows undifferentiated pleomorphic sarcoma-like or other high-grade sarcoma morphology; MDM2 amplification is a defining event and CDK4 is co-amplified in most cases
cellular_states_and_lineage.lineage_plasticity: WD  DD progression represents lineage dedifferentiation within the same clonal population; DD component maintains the 12q13-15 amplicon (including MDM2 and often CDK4/HMGA2), revealing shared origin despite morphologic dedifferentiation
